# Guidelines
- Always make a plan and execute step by step.
- Propose and implement the most suitable approach - the one that optimally balances low code complexity and high performance/low latency
- Always write clean, simple, efficient code that effectively fulfills the user request.
- Use any libraries that are helpful. Limit the amount of custom code.
- Precise, efficient and concise code implementations are of paramount importance.
- Add comments only when completely essential.
- When using try except blocks, raise errors so that processes do not continue until critical steps are resolved.

## Backend - Python

### Code Quality
- Modularize code into files based on functionality.
- Write concise Google-style docstrings.
- Add a very simple logging approach. Only log critical errors, few important checkpoints and progress updates in async processes.
